Description: Add frontend/public/robots.txt with allow rules for production host and disallow rules for staging/non-prod hosts via deployment override.
Acceptance Criteria: Production allows crawl for public marketing and invite surfaces; staging is noindex/disallow; validated with curl in both environments.

Summary: Generate XML sitemap for public routes
Description: Add build step that emits sitemap.xml for '/', '/pricing', '/privacy', '/terms', '/refund-policy', '/sms-policy' and selected public invite/help routes.
Acceptance Criteria: sitemap.xml is deployed at site root; only canonical public URLs included; Search Console accepts sitemap with no critical errors.

Description: Ensure canonical URL tags are emitted for public pages and add hreflang baseline (en) to prevent duplicate indexing across domains.
Dependencies: Generate XML sitemap for public routes
Acceptance Criteria: All public marketing/legal pages include canonical tags; canonical host is festio.events; no canonical loops detected.

Description: Implement route-level title and description updates for landing, pricing, legal and public invite pages in SPA runtime.
Acceptance Criteria: Each target route renders unique title and description in browser; social debuggers and crawler snapshots show route-appropriate metadata.

Description: Inject JSON-LD for Organization and WebSite entities in frontend/index.html with production-safe URLs and contact/profile fields.
Acceptance Criteria: Google Rich Results test parses valid Organization/WebSite schema; no syntax errors; fields match brand profile.

Description: Publish SoftwareApplication/Product style schema on landing and pricing pages with key capabilities and offer summary.
Acceptance Criteria: Schema validates and represents core product accurately; pricing representation avoids unsupported/ambiguous fields.

Summary: Add FAQPage schema for high-intent questions
Description: Create curated FAQ section and JSON-LD for top questions (pricing, RSVP, QR check-in, refunds, messaging limits).
Acceptance Criteria: At least 8 high-intent FAQs are published; FAQ schema validates; answers are concise and policy-consistent.

Description: Refactor landing page copy so major intents start with direct 1-2 sentence answers before detail paragraphs.
Acceptance Criteria: Top 6 user intents are answered above the fold or near relevant sections; readability score and heading structure pass editorial review.

Description: Publish competitor-neutral comparison page with factual answer blocks (who it is for, fees, messaging, check-in scope).
Acceptance Criteria: Page is indexable, legally reviewed, and linked from pricing; includes structured headings and source-backed claims.

Description: Extend existing static generation approach (similar to scripts/gen-guide-html.mjs) to emit crawlable static marketing snapshot for key public content.
Dependencies: Generate XML sitemap for public routes
Acceptance Criteria: Generated static HTML exists in dist for selected routes, contains core copy and links, and is retrievable without JavaScript execution.

Description: Add CI/script checks that fetch homepage/pricing with JS disabled user agents and verify title/meta/canonical/schema presence.
Acceptance Criteria: CI job fails on missing critical SEO fields; report artifact lists pass/fail checks for each URL.

Summary: Unify OG metadata source of truth
Description: Align frontend static OG tags and backend dynamic OG router fields so event/public links have consistent brand + content rules.
Acceptance Criteria: Preview cards for landing/pricing and invite links are consistent; no conflicting og:title/description/image patterns.

Description: Create deterministic social image generation workflow for landing, pricing, and event share defaults with 1200x630 assets.
Dependencies: Unify OG metadata source of truth
Acceptance Criteria: All target pages return valid OG image URLs; cards pass Meta/X/LinkedIn validators with expected visuals.

Summary: Define SEO and AEO KPI schema
Description: Define events and dashboards for impressions, non-brand clicks, CTR, indexed pages, AI referral/citation mentions, and answer-block coverage.
Acceptance Criteria: KPI definitions documented and approved; dashboard fields mapped to analytics sources; owners assigned.

Summary: Implement search console and analytics ingestion
Description: Connect Search Console exports and web analytics to weekly report pipeline for SEO/AEO tracking.
Dependencies: Define SEO and AEO KPI schema
Acceptance Criteria: Weekly automated report produced with trend deltas and top query groups; alert thresholds documented.

Summary: Add AI referral and citation tracking
Description: Tag and classify traffic/referrals from AI assistants and monitor citation presence for priority queries.
Dependencies: Implement search console and analytics ingestion
Acceptance Criteria: AI-sourced sessions are visible in reporting; top priority query/citation scoreboard is published weekly.

Description: Define writing rules for answer blocks: factuality, citation style, claim substantiation, and anti-hype policy.
Acceptance Criteria: Guardrail doc approved; PR template includes checklist; 100% of new marketing pages use checklist.

Summary: Add metadata/schema QA checklist to release
Description: Extend release QA to include robots, sitemap, canonical, schema, OG, and broken-link checks for public pages.
Acceptance Criteria: Release checklist updated and used in staging and prod; at least one dry run completed without critical gaps.

Description: Run phase-1 in sequence: foundation -> schema -> answer blocks -> validation -> submit sitemap and monitor.
Dependencies: Add metadata/schema QA checklist to release
Acceptance Criteria: Phase-1 checklist reaches done state; sitemap submitted; baseline KPI snapshot captured at launch and +14 days.

Description: After launch, review top query gaps and publish 3 additional answer pages/FAQ clusters based on data.
Acceptance Criteria: Three new high-intent pages are published; internal links added; KPI report shows early visibility movement.
